review.notes: Token-level diff of all 44 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown (case/punctuation-normalized, LaTeX math treated as equivalent), plus structural check: the three code fences (json/json/txt prompt examples) are balanced; headings match the printed section tree. Rendered physical pages 2, 7, 9, 31, 41 at 110-300 dpi. Page 2 confirms 'We summarize our contributions as follows:' is a plain body sentence, not a heading (patch 1). Page 9 confirms dropped footnote 1 (URL) and page 41 confirms dropped footnote 2 (MITL chance) - both anchors keep their superscript markers in the OCR while the bodies were absent everywhere. Page 31 shows the source prints 64^3 and 16^3 voxels with true superscripts, so the OCR LaTeX (64^{3}, 16^{3}) is faithful and the flattened text-layer '643'/'163' is not a defect. 'Inaccurate'/'Sampler'/'Methodology' on p.7 and axis ticks on p.36 live only inside Figure 5/figure plots; OCR correctly omits them. The PDF itself prints 'intial noise state' (sic, p.31) while the OCR normalized it to 'initial'; left unchanged per the no-author-typo-patches rule, and 'commonsense priors' (p.36, printed hyphenated across lines) kept as the OCR dehyphenation.
